notes:
### New
- **Import Rekordbox and Engine DJ libraries into OpenCrate.** Sync →
  Libraries: *To* OpenCrate, then tick the libraries on this computer. Adds the
  songs and playlists OpenCrate doesn't have (where their files are: nothing is
  copied or moved) and keeps every library's cues, loops, grid and info for each
  song, so you can switch between them. Which one songs use follows your
  Settings; tempo, key and rating are filled in where empty; Rekordbox's own
  sampler files can be left out. Only adds; the libraries aren't changed.
